_: Each entry is one fault, the exact edit that plants it, and per ctest
label the tests that must fail because of it. tools/mutate.py applies them
one at a time, so this file is a check rather than a record of one.
An empty list is a finding, not an omission: it says that label does not
catch that fault, and names which fault. Do not clear a list to make a run
green. Either the test that should catch it is written, or the survival is
reported. null means the verdict has not been established yet, which is
A mutant with only a fast line is one the per-push suite catches, so there
is no question left for the pr label to answer. The four with both are the
provenance never appears here. It fails under every mutant by construction,
because planting a fault edits an engine source and that is exactly what it
watches for; tools/mutate.py excludes it from every verdict and says why.
find must occur exactly once in file, or the driver refuses. That is what
keeps an entry honest across a refactor: a fault whose site has moved stops
the run instead of silently planting nothing and reporting the suite clean.
